evidence.query: Louvre Pyramid I. M. Pei design presented 1984 construction completed opened 1989

results.title: The “Pyramid” Project - Espace presse du musée du Louvre

evidence.summaryExcerpt: Design and presentation: Pei was selected in 1983. The pyramid structure was initially designed by Pei in late 1983 and presented to the public in early 1984. Opening: Sources agree on 1989 but differ on the day. Wikipedia's Grand Louvre article says the pyramid and underground complex was opened on 29 March 1989. The Louvre's own press material says it was inaugurated on March 30, 1989. Wikipedia's Grands Projets chronology lists a separate 4 March 1988: Inauguration of the Louvre Pyramid, which conflicts with the other sources. The pyramid was controversial at first.

claimResults.note: The search confirms the glass pyramid and a 1989 opening (the Louvre's own press material: inaugurated 30 March 1989), but the summary reports a conflicting 4 March 1988 'inauguration of the Louvre Pyramid' and dates the design to late 1983 and early 1984. 'Completed in 1989' cannot be confirmed as written.

evidence.restatement: The entrance is a glass pyramid, not a dome, a cube or a sphere.
I. M. Pei was born in Guangzhou (Canton), China.
The plan drew fierce public criticism in France when it was unveiled in 1984.

claimResults.note: The S3 summary also says the pyramid was controversial at first, but that call reports a date conflict, so it is not used as evidence here.

evidence.restatement: Pei insisted on special low-iron glass from Saint-Gobain, so the pyramid is clear without the usual green tint.

issues.note: The stem says Pei 'designed' the entrance 'for the Louvre in 1989'. He presented the design in early 1984; 1989 is the opening (the Louvre's press material: inaugurated 30 March 1989), and one chronology gives a 4 March 1988 inauguration. Reword, for example 'the glass entrance, opened in 1989, that architect I. M. Pei designed for the Louvre', or drop the year, and align c1 ('completed in 1989') with it. Doubt on c1.

evidence.restatement: Pei's glass pyramid, the Louvre's main entrance, was completed and inaugurated in March 1989 (the design dates from 1983 to 1984).

claimResults.note: As written, 'completed in 1989' is correct; the stem's wording is the problem (see issues). High-risk: counts only with external evidence in the other check (§9.9).

evidence.restatement: The Louvre entrance is a pyramid, not a dome, cube or sphere.
I. M. Pei was born in Guangzhou (then Canton), China, in 1917.
The pyramid plan was fiercely criticised when it was unveiled in the mid-1980s.
The panes were made of especially clear, low-iron glass without the usual green tint.

issues.note: The stem says Pei 'designed' the entrance 'in 1989'. The pyramid was designed in 1983 to 1984 and completed (inaugurated) in 1989, which is what claim c1 says. Reword the stem to 'completed' or 'opened in 1989' so player-facing text does not state a wrong design date. The key is unaffected.

editor.reason: A and B both revise. The stem says Pei designed the entrance in 1989, but the design dates from 1983 to 1984 and 1989 is the opening; A also leaves key claim c1 ('completed in 1989') uncertain, because its search reports a conflicting 1988 inauguration date. A revise/revise pair cannot pass §9.9 rule 2 without fresh checks, and a stem change needs a fresh refute check (§9.7). Cut. Redraft under a new id as the glass entrance that opened in 1989.
